description: Purchase a catalog item and place it at `(x,y,level)` facing `dir`. Transaction is verified server-side: price debited via `GlobalLink.PerformTransaction`, then `Verified=true`, then re-applied on the lot's VM. Cost: the catalog price (with build-mode discount) from the caller's budget; refunded if placement fails. Prerequisite: build-roommate+ on the target lot, lot not full, donate-mode only if allowed.
